environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on an EC2 instance in a VPC with default security groups. Instance has IAM role with S3 and DynamoDB access. No egress filtering. Instance metadata service v1 (IMDSv1) enabled. Service runs directly on the host with no network namespace isolation. Internal services (Redis on 6379, Elasticsearch on 9200) accessible on the same subnet at 10.0.1.0/24.
